skills.name: Composite - Probe for a signal
skills.description: Use a probe to detect a signal from a measurement tool or device

steps.activity: Position the probe near the signal_source
Measure the signal from the probe
Observe the measured signal and compare it to the observed_signal
steps.category: Listen to or observe instructions or signals

examples: Use an outlet tester to confirm that a receptacle is powered
Use a magnetic stud finder to locate a ceiling stud

skills.name: Composite - Test a painted surface for lead
skills.description: Expose all coating layers, activate and apply a chemical test swab, and inspect both the sample and a verification control to determine whether lead is present.

steps.activity: Cut through the coating layers on the painted_surface with the scoring_tool to expose a representative test area
steps.category: Composite - Cut an object on a particular location

steps.activity: Press or crush the reagent chambers in the test swab to activate them
Shake the test swab to mix its reagents
Rub the test swab against the exposed coating layer on the painted_surface
Inspect the test swab and painted_surface for the specified color response
Press the test swab to the verification card to dispense the reagent
Inspect the verification card for its control response
steps.category: Inspect to check state or find issues

examples: Use a swab to test layered paint on an older door casing for lead before sanding or scraping
